title: PositionWorkflowInput
description: Input to PositionWorkflow at start. Phase 0 ships the DTO slot; the workflow body lands in Phase 3.

entry_signal_id.description: signal_id of the BTO that opened the position. Disambiguates re-BTO on the same OCC under WorkflowIDReusePolicy.REJECT_DUPLICATE.

contract_symbol.description: OCC option symbol (e.g., NVDA250516C00140000). Set as a Search Attribute 'ContractSymbol' on workflow start for STC dispatch.

entry_premium.description: Fill premium per contract, dollars (source-of-truth: broker fill, not author-posted price).

source_signal_workflow_id.description: Workflow ID of the CopytradeSignalWorkflow that spawned this position. Optional; useful for cross-workflow audit correlation.
